_about: Toggle 15 shot briefs, one frame per ad (plan.json), generated 9:16 so the Story is composed first; the Feed is cropped from the middle, so each subject sits in the middle 70% of the height. prompts.py joins shot + fidelity lock + scale + scene + light + grade + negatives. Every shot gives the 15 mm ring a referent it must match (the 4 Nov pilot T01 drew it about 1.5x large against the neck and the pave bar two stones wide). The links are flat solid closed ovals, never bent wire (judge's note for the gem-clip shots).

shots.status: shot 4 Nov, job 545a1ae0: clasp built right (gate, collars, push-pin nub, both jump rings), but the pave bar is two stones wide and the clasp reads about 1.5x large against the neck creases; replaced by T01b
shots.shot: Extreme close-up beauty macro photograph for a fine-jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame, of the base of a woman's throat and her upper breastbone only: the field of view is only about 8 centimetres wide, and the top edge of the frame sits at the hollow of the throat, so no chin, jaw, lips or face are in frame.
shots.scale: the whole frame is only about 8cm wide, so the 15mm ring spans about one fifth of the frame width; the skin shows true-size pores and fine vellus hairs, and the inner ends of the two collarbones just show at the upper left and upper right edges
shots.scene: the necklace is worn closed with the clasp turned to the front, the ring resting centred on the breastbone about 6cm below the hollow of the throat, in the middle of the frame; the two strands of paperclip links climb out of the top corners of the frame; warm medium-brown Indian skin with natural texture and a faint sheen, the soft neckline of an ivory silk camisole just entering at the very bottom edge; a dark believable contact shadow where the ring rests on the skin.

shots.shot: Top-down overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame.
shots.scale: each ordinary office gem clip is about 33mm long and 8mm wide, three times the length of one 11mm necklace link, so the necklace's links read clearly smaller and finer than the clips; the 15mm ring is about half a gem clip long
shots.scene: on a pale blush paper desk, ordinary silver steel gem clips (office paperclips of bent wire) are laid in neat, evenly spaced parallel rows that fill the whole frame like a printed pattern, every clip pointing the same way; the gold necklace lies closed across the rows in one long, loose diagonal loop from the upper left to the lower right, the clasp done up just below the middle of the frame; the clips nearest the chain have been nudged aside, leaving a narrow clean channel of blush paper all along the gold, as if it had been given its own room; the necklace's links are solid polished closed ovals, clearly different from the bent-wire clips; every clip is plain silver, none gold, none coloured; a believable contact shadow under the gold.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft overhead window light from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp bright line along the gold and makes the steel clips glint cool and silvery; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.neg: No coloured clips, no gold clips, no binder clips, no other stationery, nothing else on the desk.

shots.shot: Top-down overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, on a flat saturated cobalt-blue paper ground.
shots.scale: the paperclip shape the chain draws is about 15cm tall and 4.5cm wide, so each 11mm link is a short stroke of its outline; the 15mm ring is the size of a fingernail
shots.scene: the gold necklace lies open and has been laid by hand into the outline of one giant classic paperclip, the familiar bent-wire shape with three long rounded turns, standing upright in the middle of the frame with wide empty blue all round it; the chain draws the clip's wire in one continuous line; the round spring-gate ring sits at the inner end of the wire and the pave bar at the outer end; the links stay flat solid closed ovals; no office paperclip anywhere in frame.
shots.light: LIGHT: hard low sun from the upper left casts one crisp shadow of every link onto the blue paper; a small hard specular puts a bright edge along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.grade: Palette: saturated cobalt blue and warm-neutral 18k gold, never brassy, orange or greenish. Natural film grain; editorial still-life quality.
shots.neg: No office paperclips, no other shapes, no text printed on the paper.

shots.shot: Close-up lifestyle photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman's upper chest and collarbones in a plain black square-neck top, cropped just below the chin so no face shows.
shots.scale: the friend's fingertip is about 16mm wide, about the width of the 15mm ring
shots.scene: she wears the gold necklace with the clasp at the front; from the right edge of the frame a second woman's hand reaches in, slim, with natural short nails, a slightly lighter warm skin tone and no rings, and lifts the clasp a little off the wearer's chest between thumb and index finger to look at it closely; the ring and the pave bar are sharp, unhidden and in the middle of the frame, the bar lying across the ring; both strands of the chain rise out of the top of the frame; daylight in a cafe, a softly blurred warm background; each hand has five natural fingers.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft daylight from a window at the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.neg: No second face, no cups, no food, no phone.

shots.shot: Top-down overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, on a pale blush paper ground.
shots.scale: each paper loop is about 35mm long and 12mm wide, about three times the length of one 11mm gold link, so the gold chain reads clearly finer
shots.scene: a child's school craft paper chain made of pastel paper strips in pink, butter yellow, mint and lilac, each strip glued into a loop through the one before, comes down from the top of the frame in a gentle curve; just above the middle of the frame its last paper loop passes through the small jump ring at one end of the gold necklace, and the necklace carries on down the frame in a soft curve of links of the same elongated shape, three times smaller, finishing at the lower third in its round spring-gate ring; the pave bar hangs at the jump ring where the paper meets the gold; the paper is matte with soft creases and a little uneven glue.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft daylight from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp bright line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.grade: Palette: pastel pink, butter yellow, mint, lilac, blush; warm-neutral 18k gold, never brassy, orange or greenish. Natural film grain.
shots.neg: No scissors, no glue stick, no glitter, no other craft things.

shots.shot: Close-up beauty macro photograph for a fine-jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame, of a woman's upper breastbone where the necklace's clasp rests, the field of view about 7 centimetres wide and the frame starting well below the hollow of the throat, so no neck creases, chin or face are in frame.
shots.scale: the frame is about 7cm wide, so the 15mm ring spans only about one fifth of the frame width; the tip of her left index finger rests on the chain just to the left of the clasp, the fingertip about 16mm wide, slightly wider than the ring and about four links long; skin pores and fine vellus hairs at true size
shots.scene: the necklace is worn closed with the clasp turned to the front and centred, a little above the middle of the frame, the two strands of paperclip links climbing out of the top corners; warm medium-brown Indian skin, natural texture and a faint sheen; the soft neckline of an ivory silk camisole crosses the lower third; a dark believable contact shadow under the ring.
shots.optics: Honest macro optics: depth of field only a few millimetres deep, so the clasp is needle-sharp and the chain softens as it climbs.

shots.shot: Top-down overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, on a flat saturated deep oxblood-red paper ground.
shots.scale: the word is about 12cm wide and 7cm tall, so each 11mm link is a small stroke of it; the 15mm ring is the size of a fingernail
shots.scene: the gold necklace lies open and is arranged by hand into the lowercase word 'hi' in joined-up handwriting, centred in the frame: the chain draws the 'h' and the stem of the 'i' in one continuous line, the pave bar at the top of the h's tall stroke, and the round ring sitting just above the stem of the 'i' as its dot, joined to it by its last link; the word is clearly legible; nothing else on the paper.
shots.light: LIGHT: hard low sun from the upper left casts a crisp shadow of every link onto the paper; a small hard specular puts a bright edge along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.grade: Palette: deep oxblood red and warm-neutral 18k gold, never brassy, orange or greenish. Natural film grain; editorial still-life quality.
shots.neg: No other letters, no second word, no text printed on the paper.

shots.shot: Close-up photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman who has just done up her necklace at the front, cropped just below the chin so no face shows.
shots.scale: her fingertips are about 16mm wide, slightly wider than the 15mm ring
shots.scene: the clasp is done up at the centre of her upper chest, the pave bar lying across the ring; her right hand's thumb and index finger are just letting go of the ring, the hand relaxed, five natural fingers, short neutral nails, no rings; the chain runs round her neck and over her collarbones; she wears a soft ivory cotton camisole; warm morning bedroom light, a softly blurred warm wall.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft warm morning window light from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp line along the gold and puts a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.

shots.ad: 08 Plain white tee, fixed. (the 'after'; the 'before' is an edit that paints the chain out)
shots.shot: Fashion photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman in a plain white cotton crew-neck t-shirt, from just below the chin to the middle of her chest, so no face shows.
shots.scale: the tee's ribbed neckband is about 2cm wide, a little wider than the 15mm ring
shots.scene: the gold necklace is worn over the tee: the chain comes out from under the neckband at both sides of the neck and falls onto the white cotton in a soft U, the clasp done up and turned to the front at the centre of her chest, a little above the middle of the frame; the cotton has a soft natural weave and a few gentle folds; plain warm-white wall behind; even, simple, honest.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft daylight from a window at the left with a gentle shadow side; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.

shots.shot: Advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, from the point of view of someone being handed a gift.
shots.scale: the square gift box is about 8cm across, so the 15mm ring is about a fifth of the box's width; her fingertips are about 16mm wide
shots.scene: a woman's two hands, cropped at the wrists, five natural fingers each, short neutral nails, no rings, hold out an open square blush-pink rigid gift box towards the camera, a little below the middle of the frame; inside, on a blush satin pad, the gold necklace lies coiled with its clasp on top; the box is plain, with no lettering or logo visible on any side; behind her hands, a soft out-of-focus warm living room.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft warm window light from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.neg: No lettering, no logo, no ribbon, no other gifts.

shots.shot: Lifestyle photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman at the end of the working day, cropped just below the chin so no face shows.
shots.scale: the blank ID card is a standard 86 by 54mm card, several times the width of the 15mm ring
shots.scene: she wears a crisp pale-blue cotton office shirt with the top two buttons open; with her right hand she lifts a navy-blue woven fabric lanyard off her neck, pulling it up and out to the side, its blank white plastic ID card swinging at the lower left, no logo, no text, no photo on the card; the gold necklace stays on her collarbone in the open collar, the clasp at the front centre, catching warm light; an office lift lobby softly blurred behind in warm dusk light; one hand with five natural fingers.
shots.light: LIGHT: warm evening light from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.neg: No text, logo or photo on the ID card or lanyard, no laptop bag, no phone.

shots.ad: 11 One to give. One to keep.
shots.shot: Three-quarter overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame.
shots.scale: each square gift box is about 8cm across, so each 15mm ring is about a fifth of a box's width
shots.scene: two identical open square blush-pink rigid gift boxes stand side by side on blush linen in the middle of the frame, each holding one of two identical gold necklaces coiled on a blush satin pad with its clasp on top; a small blank kraft-paper tag is tied with thin cotton string to the left box only; the two lids lean behind the boxes; the boxes are plain, with no lettering or logo; soft air above.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft daylight from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.neg_base: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no other jewellery, no earrings, no rings, no bracelets; exactly two necklaces, one in each box, identical.
shots.neg: No writing on the tag, no ribbon, no other gifts.

shots.shot: Fashion photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman in a crisp white cotton kurta with a deep round neckline, no buttons and no embroidery, from just below the chin to the middle of her chest, so no face shows.
shots.scale: the kurta's neckline is about 16cm across; the 15mm ring is about the width of a fingertip
shots.scene: the gold necklace sits at the neckline on her skin, the clasp done up and turned to the front just above the kurta's edge, in the middle of the frame; the cotton is crisp with a fine visible weave; a plain warm lime-plaster wall behind; an everyday morning.
shots.light: LIGHT: low morning side light from a window at the left rakes across, so each paperclip link shows its own small highlight; one small hard specular kicker from the right puts a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.

shots.shot: Advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman's hand, fingers only from the knuckles, holds the necklace up by its chain between thumb and index finger near the top right of the frame.
shots.scale: the fingertip is about 16mm wide, slightly wider than the 15mm ring
shots.scene: the necklace hangs from her fingers in a long narrow loop with the clasp done up at the bottom, in front of a smooth warm lime-plaster wall; one small hard light close behind the camera throws the necklace's shadow onto the wall behind it, the shadow about three times larger than the necklace and offset down and to the left, every paperclip link and the ring's round shadow crisp and readable; the necklace itself stays small and sharp; five natural fingers.
shots.light: LIGHT: one small hard point light close behind the camera; a soft warm fill from the left; a crisp specular line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.

shots.shot: Macro advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, on pale blush silk.
shots.scale: the frame is about 5cm wide; each link is 11mm long and 4mm wide
shots.scene: two links of the gold necklace sit in razor-sharp focus in the middle of the frame, interlocked and crossing on the diagonal at about 45 degrees, so together they look exactly like the familiar 'link' icon of two linked ovals; the rest of the chain runs out of focus at both ends, and the ring clasp lies soft in the background at the lower right so the picture reads as a necklace; mirror polish with one crisp specular on each of the two links.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft daylight from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right; the clear stones on the out-of-focus bar stay colourless.
shots.optics: Honest macro optics: depth of field only a few millimetres deep, so the two crossing links are needle-sharp and everything else falls softly out of focus.

shots.shot: Close-up fashion photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman's neck and upper chest in a chocolate-brown fine-gauge ribbed knit turtleneck, cropped just below the chin so no face shows.
shots.scale: the fine knit ribs are about 3mm apart; the fingertips of her right hand lightly touch the chain at the side, each fingertip about 16mm wide, the same width as the 15mm ring
shots.scene: the gold necklace is worn over the knit, the 50cm chain falling from under the folded turtleneck collar onto the chest in a soft U, the clasp done up and turned to the front at the centre, a little below the middle of the frame, sitting on top of the fine knit, not sinking into it; a warm cream wall softly out of focus behind; a believable shadow where the chain lies on the knit; one hand with five natural fingers.
shots.light: LIGHT: low warm winter sun from a window at the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp bright line along the gold and puts a pin-point white catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.grade: Palette: chocolate brown, cocoa, warm cream; warm-neutral 18k gold, never brassy, orange or greenish. Natural film grain, believable imperfection; editorial demi-fine jewellery campaign quality.
